newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy PCI Lease - Sun Hung Kai.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy PCI Lease - Sun Hung Kai.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Securities (Phils) Inc on Tuesday reiterated its buy rating on PCI Leasing & Finance Corp after it announced an 87 percent hike in its net income for 1996.
PCI Leasing reported a 261.3 million peso net income last year from the 1995 audited net of 140 million pesos.

"The better-than-expected 1996 performance shows management's good grasp of numbers. We still recommend a buy on the stock as the current price gives a valuation of 15.1 times 1997 earnings," a Sun Hung Kai study said.
PCI Leasing was down 10 centavos at 8.20 pesos in late trade on Tuesday.
